do.rule: Keep all props such as gourds, bombillas, and thermoses correctly proportioned relative to the figures holding them.

avoid.rule: Avoid reusing the exact same static close-up frame multiple times consecutively without a change in expression, angle, or action.
Avoid using board templates that display only plain text without any visual icons, props, or characters.

recentBad: shot 1: The phrase 'LA ÚLTIMA' repeats across multiple consecutive frames without new visual content
Shot 1, 2, 3: Board templates display text only with no visual graphic elements corresponding to the spoken words.
Shot 6: Board template relies entirely on plain typography without supporting illustrations.
Shot 0: Captions at the top overlap slightly with the upper screen border elements.
Shot 5: The highlight lines on the text labels feel visually detached from the design.
